games.name: Fortnite
games.yaw_note: Degrees per count per 1% of 'Mouse Sensitivity X' (percent scale, e.g. 6.4% = legacy 0.064). Y axis is separate; Targeting/Scope are % multipliers of X/Y.
games.config_file: %LOCALAPPDATA%\FortniteGame\Saved\Config\WindowsClient\GameUserSettings.ini (UE INI; graphics). Sens/keybinds also cloud-synced to the Epic account (ClientSettings.Sav).

settings.label: Building Mode Sensitivity Multiplier
settings.note: Shown when advanced/multiplier options are enabled

settings.label: Edit Mode Sensitivity Multiplier
settings.note: Shown when advanced/multiplier options are enabled

games.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 / Warzone
games.yaw_note: Degrees per count per 1.00 of 'Mouse Sensitivity' (same scale as MW2019+ and Warzone). ADS depends on ADS Sensitivity Multiplier + Monitor Distance Coefficient + ADS FOV setting.
games.config_file: Documents\Call of Duty\players\ (BO6 options text files, e.g. s.1.0.cod24.txt0/.txt1; partly cloud-synced to the Activision account; file names unverified)

settings.label: Audio Mix
settings.note: Presets include Home Theater, Headphones, Headphones Bass Boost, Night Mode, Treble Boost, Bass Boost (list varies per title)

settings.label: Automatic Airborne Mantle / Automatic Ground Mantle

games.name: Rainbow Six Siege X
games.yaw_note: Degrees per count per 1 of 'Mouse Sensitivity Horizontal' (MouseYawSensitivity) with default MouseSensitivityMultiplierUnit = 0.02 in GameSettings.ini; scale yaw by (unit/0.02) if changed. ADS per scope is a % of hip-fire.

settings.label: MouseSensitivityMultiplierUnit (ini only)
settings.note: Not in menu; scales all mouse sens

settings.label: Aim Down Sights 1.0x
settings.note: Per-zoom ADS sliders since Shadow Legacy (1.0x, 1.5x, 2.0x, 2.5x, 3.0x, 4.0x, 5.0x, 12.0x)

settings.label: Dynamic Range
settings.note: Presets like Night Mode / TV / Hi-Fi; Siege X reworked audio, verify labels

games.name: Valorant
games.yaw_note: Degrees per count per 1.0 of 'Sensitivity: Aim'. FOV fixed (103 horizontal), so no FOV setting.
games.config_file: %LOCALAPPDATA%\VALORANT\Saved\Config\<account-id>\Windows\GameUserSettings.ini (graphics only); sensitivity, keybinds and crosshair are stored server-side on the Riot account.

games.name: Counter-Strike 2
games.yaw_note: m_yaw 0.022 degrees per count per 1.0 of 'sensitivity'. FOV fixed at 90 (4:3 horizontal), not adjustable.

settings.label: Mouse Sensitivity
settings.note: convar 'sensitivity'; console allows beyond the slider

games.name: Apex Legends
games.yaw_note: Source-engine style: 0.022 degrees per count per 1.0 of 'Mouse Sensitivity' (same as CS2).
games.config_file: %USERPROFILE%\Saved Games\Respawn\Apex\local\settings.cfg (convar text, mouse_sensitivity etc.) + videoconfig.txt; profile\profile.cfg for binds.

settings.label: ADS Mouse Sensitivity Multiplier
settings.note: Used when Per Optic is Off

games.name: Overwatch 2
games.yaw_note: Degrees per count per 1 of 'Sensitivity'. Zoom sens (Widowmaker/Ana/Ashe) is a % of hip-fire ('Relative Aim Sensitivity While Zoomed').
games.config_file: Documents\Overwatch\Settings\Settings_v0.ini (graphics/audio INI); sensitivity and keybinds are synced to the Battle.net account.

settings.label: Sensitivity
settings.note: Global, can be overridden per hero

games.name: Battlefield 6
games.yaw_note: Non-linear: SensLab models hip-fire as 0.00173623 * sens + 0.00231498 deg/count; another converter stores slider / 1333.33 in the profile. Use a non-linear converter or measure; ADS also depends on Zoom Sensitivity Coefficient and Uniform Infantry Aiming.

settings.label: Infantry Mouse Aim Sensitivity
settings.note: PROFSAVE: GstInput.MouseSensitivity; slider moves in whole numbers

settings.label: Zoom Sensitivity Coefficient
settings.note: Per guides 178 is default; range unverified

games.name: PUBG: Battlegrounds
games.yaw_note: Menu slider (1-100) is exponential; the game applies the linear LastConvertedSensitivity from GameUserSettings.ini (0.02 at slider 50). Linear yaw only valid on LastConvertedSensitivity; csdb lists 0.002222 but scale is ambiguous, so null.
games.config_file: %LOCALAPPDATA%\TslGame\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor\GameUserSettings.ini (UE INI; sens entries hold Sensitivity + LastConvertedSensitivity per mode)

games.name: Marvel Rivals
games.yaw_note: Degrees per count per 1.0 of 'Mouse Horizontal Sensitivity' (CS2 x 1.257; Overwatch x 0.375 ~ 0.0066/0.0176). Third-person camera; per-hero overrides exist. One converter (csdb) lists 0.022, judged wrong.

settings.label: Hero-specific sensitivity (All Heroes > hero)
settings.note: Per-hero scope/zoom multipliers on some heroes

settings.label: Low Latency Mode
settings.note: NVIDIA Reflex; AMD Anti-Lag 2 on AMD

games.name: The Finals
games.yaw_note: Degrees per count per 1 of the menu sensitivity (CS2 sens x 22; OW2 sens x 6.6). Source: SensLab; one older SensLab page still shows 0.0066 (outdated).
games.config_file: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Discovery\Saved\Config\WindowsClient\GameUserSettings.ini (UE INI; 'Discovery' = internal project name; unverified by official source)

games.name: Escape from Tarkov
games.yaw_note: Degrees per count per 1.0 of 'Mouse sensitivity' (CS2 x 0.176). Third-party value; turn speed is further reduced in-game by gear weight/ergonomics.
games.config_file: %APPDATA%\Battlestate Games\Escape from Tarkov\Settings\ (Control.ini, Game.ini, Graphics.ini, Sound.ini; JSON content despite .ini extension; older installs in Documents\Escape from Tarkov)

games.name: Destiny 2
games.yaw_note: Degrees per count per 1 of 'Look Sensitivity' (same as OW2/CoD per SensLab and csdb). ADS uses 'ADS Sensitivity Modifier' plus per-weapon zoom.

games.name: ARC Raiders
games.yaw_note: Released (UE5). No verified public yaw constant (mouse-sensitivity.com supports it behind premium; no free source states the value). Sensitivity is a 0-100 slider, linearity unconfirmed.

settings.label: Move Crosshair When Line of Fire is Blocked

games.name: Rocket League
games.yaw_note: Car game with a chase camera; no meaningful cm/360 conversion. Store camera + controller values instead.
games.config_file: Documents\My Games\Rocket League\TAGame\Config\TASystemSettings.ini (graphics) + TAInput.ini; camera/controls in binary SaveData (.save) files.
